text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2: multiple runtime nodes hitting OOM / CUDA errors in paged-attention pool. Impacting ~3% of hosted inference requests. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/paged-kv-oom
ryan_oncall: saw alert at 02:12 UTC, starting triage. Logs show gradual resident set rise + allocator fragmentation on paged-attn.
anya_sre: confirmed container restarts on node gpu-18 and gpu-22. dmesg shows multiple 'CUDA: Out of memory' followed by k8s restart.
jordan_runtime: looks like KV cache fragmentation + small-page leakage. We saw similar slow-creep pattern but this time it drifted past eviction threshold.
lisa_support: any customer-facing errors? support metrics show 500 spikes for long-gen endpoints (chat/run) starting ~01:30 UTC. ~12 customer requests failed in last hour.
ryan_oncall: setting maintenance flags: disable paging on pool alpha for now, route traffic to pool beta. Patching autoscaler to avoid adding new pods to alpha.
anya_sre: running eviction sweep on affected nodes: `./tools/kvctl evict --target=alpha --force`
jordan_runtime: quick mitigation: bump `kv_page_eviction_threshold` from 0.72 -> 0.85 and enable aggressive slab scavenge: `-Dallocator.scavenge=2`. Rolling patch to 2 nodes first.
devops-marta: created k8s patch: `kubectl patch ds paged-attn -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"paged-attn","env":[{"name":"KV_PAGING_ENABLED","value":"false"}]}]}}}}'` applied to node gpu-22 and gpu-18.
anya_sre: post-patch logs: fragmentation stall still showing, but no new OOMs after 02:28 on patched nodes. Need to monitor for 1-2h.
ryan_oncall: customer impact note: create incident ticket and notify CS. Lisa, can you send customer advisory w/ ETA?
lisa_support: drafting now: "We're investigating increased 500s for generation APIs in a subset of requests. We've mitigated by routing traffic and will follow up with a postmortem." Sending to channel #customer-impact in 5m.
jordan_runtime: root cause hypothesis: allocator's paged-attn slab metadata not compacting due to a regression in compacting walk when KV slots are highly fragmented (workload: long convo + mixed sequence lengths). Patch candidate in review: tighten compaction watermark and add extra bookkeeping to avoid orphaned fragments.
anya_sre: action items: 1) keep paging off on alpha pool 2) drain alpha and force-swap traffic to beta 3) collect full heap/kv histograms from 02:00-02:30 4) run hotfix with allocator scavenge and higher eviction threshold to canary group.
ryan_oncall: doing handoff at 03:00 UTC to night SRE. If anyone gets paged, follow escalation in runbook. Leaving monitoring alarms with 10% higher sensitivity for next 6h.
lisa_support: CS notified, customers with errors are being contacted. No contractual SLA breach expected but we flagged for priority follow-up.
devops-marta: note: we saw a side-effect where disabling paging increased CPU on beta; watch for perf regressions. Rolling patch includes a temporary CPU limit bump.
jordan_runtime: pushing hotfix branch `fix/kv-compaction-wm` to canary. Will link PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4567
anya_sre: collecting traces and will attach to the incident ticket. Will also snapshot /proc and nvml stats for gpu nodes.
ryan_oncall: last check 02:50 UTC: error rate back to baseline for most routes, OOMs stopped on patched nodes. Leaving incident open for postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident timeline created: https://incidents.redwood/1767894321. Severity: SEV2 -> monitoring.
ryan_oncall: handoff note to night team: continue heap histograms, run full compaction patch canary at 04:15, if stable promote. Oncall pager still active for 2h.
anya_sre: quick nudge: gather any occurrences of 'cudaErrorMemoryAllocation' or 'cuMemAlloc' in logs for correlation.
lisa_support: updated customers at 03:05 UTC. Will provide follow-up email with mitigation steps and expected postmortem ETA.
ryan_oncall: thank you team :thumbsup: we'll write up postmortem after data collection. Leaving thread for night SRE to close.
